no_code_path: RFC 7606 Section 8 ('Guidance for Authors of BGP Specifications') states: 'A document that specifies a new BGP attribute MUST provide specifics regarding what constitutes an error for that attribute and how that error is to be handled.' The obligation binds the authors of future BGP attribute specifications, not a BGP speaker. Ze's declared role in rfc/short/rfc7606.md is 'BGP speaker'; Ze implements BGP protocol handling and authors no BGP attribute specification, so no reachable code path can satisfy or violate this requirement.
note: Independent re-judgment (2026-11-22) against rfc/full/rfc7606.txt Section 8, rfc/short/rfc7606.md, and rfc/extraction/rfc7606.json (site 8:1). The row's verbatim text, [MUST] level, Ze roles ('BGP speaker'), and {not-applicable} annotation accurately reflect a document-author obligation. Replaces the 2026-10-30 unimplemented placeholder recorded when the gate lacked document-author {not-applicable} evidence support; per-attribute runtime error handling belongs to Section 7 and each attribute's own RFC, not Section 8's specification-author directive. No tests tag RFC7606-8-1.
